name: Ribbon Draw — symbol draw-in
summary: Each symbol draws itself in on its own (no previous symbol): the stroke starts at the symbol's thick tip and is drawn along its length to the thin tip, with the same pen-like moving end as the transitions and a fade-only depth (no blur) — the end being drawn is full strength, the earlier part fades slightly, and everything settles to the exact symbol at the end.
units: 60 x 60 symbol box, y down. Draw each symbol's `path` translated by its `offset` to get the resting shape (exact Figma outline).
edges: `left`/`right` are flat [x0,y0,x1,y1,...] arrays: the ribbon's two edges in box coordinates (offset already applied), sampled every `sampleStep` units of centre-line length, ordered from the THICK tip to the THIN tip. Left is on the left of travel thick -> thin.

_doc.easing: cubic-bezier control points; drives how far along the symbol the drawing end is
_doc.depth.maxFade: max opacity loss at the thick tip (the oldest part)
_doc.depth.maxBlur: max blur radius as % of the 60-unit symbol box; 0 = no blur (draw-in uses fade only)

_doc.thickEndTaper: length (symbol units) over which the drawing end narrows to a point; fades out as it reaches the thin tip
_doc.depthEaseIn: share of the duration over which the depth effect ramps in
_doc.depthClear: share of the duration, at the end, over which the effect eases back to a crisp symbol
